q23.

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (the `CREATE TABLE memo` block at lines 33–44; parallel definitions exist for the other dialects in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` and `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go` (`type Memo struct` at line 35)
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`message Memo` at line 198)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`export type Memo` at line 79)

Two supporting details worth knowing: the Go model's `Payload` field is typed `*storepb.MemoPayload`, which comes from a separate store-side proto (`proto/store/memo.proto`, generated into `proto/gen/store`), so the JSON `payload` column has its own schema layer. And the Go bindings for the API message live in the generated `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go`, which is the counterpart to the frontend's `memo_service_pb.ts`.
